philosophy.title: Systems Before Code
philosophy.description: Architecture comes first. I design clean separation of concerns, proper middleware layers, and extensible API contracts before writing a single line. Code is the implementation of a good system — not the system itself.

philosophy.title: Performance is a Feature
philosophy.description: From Redis caching to query indexing, I treat performance metrics as first-class requirements — not afterthoughts. Every millisecond saved is revenue protected and user experience improved.

philosophy.title: Integration as First-Class
